sentences.en: I've been doing some research into what people in Britain think of doctors, the ones who work in general practice - the first call for medical care - and comparing this with the situation in a couple of other countries.
sentences.zh: 我最近对英国人如何看待医生——即在普通诊所执业、作为首诊医疗提供者的医生——做了一些研究，并将此与另外几个国家的情况进行了比较。

sentences.en: I want to talk about the rationale behind what I decided to do.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈我决定这样做的理由。

sentences.en: Now I had to set up my programme of research in three different countries so approached postgraduates in my field in overseas departments, contacting them by email, to organise things for me at their end.
sentences.zh: 现在我需要在三个不同的国家开展我的研究项目，因此我通过电子邮件联系了海外院系中我这一领域的研究生，请他们在当地为我安排相关事宜。

sentences.en: I thought I would have trouble recruiting help but in fact everyone was very willing and sometimes their tutors got involved too.
sentences.zh: 我原以为招募帮手会遇到困难，但实际上每个人都非常乐意帮忙，有时他们的导师也参与其中。

sentences.en: had to give my helpers clear instructions about what kind of sample population I wanted them to use.
sentences.zh: 我必须给助手们明确的指示，说明我想要他们使用的样本群体类型。

sentences.en: I decided that people under 18 should be excluded because most of them are students or looking for their first job, and also I decided at this stage just to focus on men who were in employment, and set up something for people who didn't have jobs and for employed women later on as a separate investigation.
sentences.zh: 我决定排除18岁以下的人群，因为其中大多数人是学生或正在寻找第一份工作；此外，我在此阶段仅聚焦于在职男性，而将失业者和在职女性的相关调查留待日后作为一项独立研究来开展。

sentences.en: specifically wanted to do a questionnaire, and interviews with a focus group.
sentences.zh: 我特别想采用问卷调查，并辅以焦点小组访谈。

sentences.en: With the questionnaire, rather than limiting it to one specific point, I wanted to include as much variety as possible.
sentences.zh: 对于问卷调查，我并未将其局限于某一个具体问题，而是希望尽可能涵盖多种多样的内容。

sentences.en: I know questionnaires are a very controlled way to do things but I thought could do taped interviews later on to counteract the effects of this.
sentences.zh: 我知道问卷调查是一种高度受控的研究方式，但我认为之后可以通过录音访谈来抵消这种局限性。

sentences.en: And the focus group may also prove useful in future, by targeting subjects I can easily return to, as the participants tend to be more involved.
sentences.zh: 而焦点小组未来也可能很有用，因为我可以有针对性地再次联系这些受访者，毕竟参与者通常更愿意投入。

sentences.en: So I'm just collating the results now.
sentences.zh: 所以我目前正汇总各项结果。

sentences.en: At the moment it looks as if, in the UK, despite the fact that newspapers continually report that people are unhappy with medical care, in fact it is mainly the third level of care, which takes place in hospitals, that they are worried about.
sentences.zh: 目前看来，在英国，尽管报纸持续报道民众对医疗服务不满，但事实上他们主要担忧的是发生在医院的第三级医疗服务。

sentences.en: Government reforms have been proposed at all levels and although their success is not guaranteed, long-term hospital care is in fact probably less of an issue than the media would have us believe.
sentences.zh: 政府已在各个层面提出了改革方案，虽然其成效尚无保证，但长期住院治疗实际上可能并不像媒体所渲染的那样严重。

sentences.en: However, I've still got quite a bit of data to look at.
sentences.zh: 不过，我仍需分析相当大量的数据。

sentences.en: Certainly I will need to do more far-reaching research than I had anticipated in order to establish if people want extra medical staff invested in the community, or if they want care to revert to fewer, but larger, key medical units.
sentences.zh: 当然，为了确定民众是希望在社区增加医务人员投入，还是希望回归数量较少但规模更大的核心医疗单位，我需要开展比原先预想更广泛深入的研究。

sentences.en: The solution may well be something that www.TopSage.com Tapescripts +.
sentences.zh: 解决方案很可能就是www.TopSage.com Tapescripts +。

sentences.en: LA can be easily implemented by those responsible in local government, with central government support of course.
sentences.zh: LA可由地方政府相关部门轻松实施，当然也需要中央政府的支持。

sentences.en: TopSage.com This first stage has proved very valuable though.
sentences.zh: TopSage.com 这一初步阶段已证明极具价值。

sentences.en: I was surprised by how willing most of the subjects were to get involved in the project had expected some unwillingness to answer questions honestly.
sentences.zh: 我惊讶地发现，大多数受访者都十分愿意参与本项目；我原本还担心他们不愿坦诚作答。

sentences.en: But I was taken aback and rather concerned that something I thought I'd set up very well didn't necessarily seem that way to everyone in my own department.
sentences.zh: 但我却大吃一惊，甚至有些担忧：自以为设计得非常周密的方案，在我自己部门的同事眼中却未必如此。

sentences.en: thought you might also be interested in some of the problems I encountered in collecting my data.
sentences.zh: 我想您可能也会对我在数据收集过程中遇到的一些问题感兴趣。

sentences.en: There were odd cases that threw me - one of the subjects who had approached while he was out shopping in town, decided to pull out when it came to the second round.
sentences.zh: 曾出现过一些令我措手不及的特殊情况——其中一位受访者是在镇上购物时被我接触到的，却在第二轮调查时决定退出。

sentences.en: It 037 was a shame it as it was someone who I would like to have interviewed more closely.
sentences.zh: 这实在令人遗憾，因为此人正是我本想进行更深入访谈的对象。

sentences.en: And one of the first-year students interviewed wanted reassurance that no names would be traceable from the answers.
sentences.zh: 还有一位接受访谈的一年级学生，要求确认答案中不会追溯到任何人的姓名。

sentences.en: I was so surprised, because they think nothing of telling you about themselves and their opinions in seminar groups!
sentences.zh: 我对此感到非常惊讶，因为在研讨课小组中，他们向来毫不介意向你讲述自己的情况和观点！

sentences.en: Then, one of the people that I work with got a bit funny.
sentences.zh: 接着，我一位共事的同事表现得有点古怪。

sentences.en: The questions were quite personal and one minute he said he'd do it, then the next day he wouldn't, and in the end he did do it.
sentences.zh: 那些问题相当私密，他前一分钟说愿意配合，第二天却又反悔，最后虽勉强完成了访谈。

sentences.en: It's hard not to get angry in that situation but tried to keep focused on the overall picture in order to stay calm.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下很难不生气，但我努力保持专注，着眼于整体目标，从而维持冷静。

sentences.en: The most bizarre case was a telephone interview I did with a teacher at a university in France.
sentences.zh: 最离奇的案例是我与法国一所大学一位教师进行的一次电话访谈。

sentences.en: He answered all my questions in great detail - but then when I asked how much access he had to dangerous substances he wouldn't tell me exactly what his work involved.
sentences.zh: 他详尽地回答了我所有问题——但当我问及他接触危险物质的频率时，他却拒绝透露自己工作的具体内容。

sentences.en: It's a real eye-opener...
sentences.zh: 这真是一次令人眼界大开的经历……
